name: Schema Compatibility Guard
summary: Block provably incompatible JSON Schema, Avro, and Protobuf contract edits.
description: Compares bounded before-and-after schema structure and blocks removed fields, newly required fields, narrowed JSON types, and reused Protobuf field identities.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks provably incompatible JSON Schema, Avro, and Protobuf contract edits; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not execute schema compilers or resolve remote schema references.
It does not classify SQL migrations or OpenAPI documents.
It does not certify compatibility for unsupported schema dialects.

entrypoints.purpose: Block provably incompatible JSON Schema, Avro, and Protobuf contract edits.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block provably incompatible JSON Schema, Avro, and Protobuf contract edits without deferred work.
